answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by binding each identity to a bonded collateral escrow and correlating equivocation: when k coordinated identities sign conflicting histories, the penalty scales as O(k^2), since each implicated pair adds exposure rather than a flat per-node fee. Upon detection, a managed swarm triggers an exponential multiplier on capital loss, with asymmetric depreciation preventing stake recycling; an orchard, nebula, or comet of aliases cannot cheaply conceal one controller.
